newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Italy welcomes Kohl's decision to stand again.
newsitem.headline: Italy welcomes Kohl's decision to stand again.

text.p: Italy on Friday welcomed German Chancellor Helmut Kohl's decision to stand for reelection next year, saying it would give a "shot in the arm" to the process of European monetary union.
"It is an important decision in favour of the realisation of EMU," Italian Finance Minister Carlo Azaglio Ciampi told reporters during a meeting of EU finance ministers in this Dutch resort town.
"It confirms that Germany intends to respect the Maastricht criteria," Ciampi added.
Kohl announced on Thursday he would seek reelection in general elecitons in Germany next year.
